setup.heading: Initialize Administrator
setup.description: Create the administrator account before using Certimate for the first time. Enter the one-time initialization token printed to the Certimate startup console; the token is valid for 30 minutes, and restarting Certimate issues a new one after expiry.

token.label: Initialization token
token.placeholder: Enter the token from the startup console

username.label: Email
username.invalid: Please enter a valid email address

password.label: Password
password.invalid: Password must be 10-71 characters and at most 72 UTF-8 bytes

gate.title: Service connection failed
gate.error: Unable to retrieve the initialization status. Check whether the service is reachable.
